cues: We all love Geet from Jab We Met.
But I think we can agree,
girl desperately needed
a Life Design Lab lecture.
She planned to run away and marry Anshuman,
convinced she had her future figured out.
Except...
Anshuman was a hypothesis,
not a plan.
Life prototyping is about exploring a possible future
through small experiments,
so you can test assumptions
and learn before committing.
Geet could've started with a prototype conversation,
tried a low-stakes experience together,
and discovered if their plans actually matched.
Turns out, not every life decision
needs a dramatic Bollywood plot twist.
Sometimes, it just needs a prototype.
So... what's your Anshuman?
